requirements.criterion: A result records the actual provider/model/version and available seed/settings, input policy, accepted original and license/provenance. Missing model/seed data is explicit.
requirements.required_evidence: Actual provider execution record and preserved original/hash; no injected result or capability flag as output proof.

requirements.criterion: Assess each implemented generative/segmentation/upscale task on owned or appropriately licensed unseen photographs, faces/hair/hands, graphics/text, edge/alpha cases and profiles at every supported depth/scale.
requirements.required_evidence: Pinned corpus manifest with permissions and held-out cases, qualitative intent/identity/detail review plus applicable measurements and retained failures.

requirements.criterion: Unsupported HDR/modes, capacities, architecture/system/model readiness and provider admission reject explicitly instead of silently substituting another operation or ordinary resize.
requirements.required_evidence: Native and both applicable API boundary cases with untouched source/history and truthful reasons.

requirements.criterion: Masks, alpha, colour/profile/PPI, document geometry, layer placement and source state follow each selected workflow; apply/cancel/undo/redo/reopen and late-work fences all remain correct.
requirements.required_evidence: Real native/API/provider lifecycle evidence, cold reopen and independent native-file inspection at required scales/platforms.

requirements.criterion: Compare against independent Photoshop outputs/defaults when a corresponding deterministic operation/provider contract is available. Required byte equality is not replaced by epsilon tolerances.
requirements.required_evidence: Pinned owned reference inputs/settings/results, decoded byte differences and exact source/binary/platform binding; all residuals remain open.

requirements.criterion: Name local/PCC/third-party models accurately. A different provider or quality metric does not establish Firefly/partner model identity, capabilities or Photoshop output equivalence.
requirements.required_evidence: Provider contract/access and real outputs for any claimed correspondence; explicit unsupported model features and unique-AI differences.

requirements.criterion: Preserve every published reference language entry, including Arabic/Hebrew regional UI and text behavior, without equating model languages with app localization.
requirements.required_evidence: This24-entry catalogue plus independent per-locale UI/text/keyboard references and regional variants.

requirements.criterion: Translate and validate all app-owned menus, dialogs, settings, panels, Help/errors, accessibility text, plurals/numbers/units and keyboard equivalents under the corresponding locale.
requirements.required_evidence: Localization resources and native runs on supported OS/architectures; no missing/truncated labels, mixed-language workflows or untranslated error paths.

requirements.criterion: Validate RTL paragraph shaping/composition, bidirectional mixed content, Arabic/Hebrew-specific controls and stable image coordinates independently of translated chrome.
requirements.required_evidence: Owned editable/native/PSD references and native text editing, save/reopen and visual/output comparison, not merely a reversed interface.

requirements.criterion: Report actual on-device and PCC locale support with framework fallbacks. Handle unsupported prompt/output languages before inference where possible and handle runtime unsupported-language errors honestly.
requirements.required_evidence: Separate UI/text/provider capability evidence, metadata and actual request tests on eligible devices/OS with no silent translation or English fallback.

requirements.criterion: Keep native document automation/Firefly-v2 contract compatibility separate from hosted Adobe identity, asset storage, Firefly/partner inference and other proprietary services.
requirements.required_evidence: Per-endpoint contract tests and provider-specific authorized execution/access, not a matching route/menu as proof of Adobe service use.

requirements.criterion: Optional Apple on-device/PCC services preserve ordinary macOS14+ editing, explicitly disclose processing/input policy and use real device/system/model/managed-entitlement admission.
requirements.required_evidence: Signed physical-device readiness/inference evidence; missing-entitlement and unavailable-model paths; no fabricated entitlement or automatic proprietary substitution.

requirements.criterion: Inventory modern UXP, legacy CEP, native SDK filters/tools and optional format plugins separately; distinguish ExtendScript automation from each host runtime.
requirements.required_evidence: Public format/API references, licensed SDK access where required, complete host/architecture/supported-operation compatibility matrix.

requirements.criterion: Implement and qualify each claimed host API, DOM/action/modal semantics, permissions, lifecycle, event delivery and UI integration through the native engine. Native HTTP automation does not by itself run UXP/CEP/JSX/binary plugins.
requirements.required_evidence: Owned sample extensions and authorized real plugins execute in Photato with matching results/history and independent Photoshop comparison.

requirements.criterion: Qualify plugin architecture/OS/ABI/signature and isolation, fault/crash/memory/time/cancel behavior and user-authorized file/network access. Preserve app and source data on plugin failure.
requirements.required_evidence: Runtime containment/termination and transaction tests, signed sandbox physical-platform runs; no broad security weakening as an assumed implementation shortcut.

requirements.criterion: Prove the chosen distribution/extension mechanism under relevant current Apple rules before claiming Store-compatible arbitrary plugin execution. Preserve completely free/manual-release policies.
requirements.required_evidence: Concrete host/package design and Apple-supported mechanism/review outcome as applicable.2.4.5/2.5.2 and4.7 requirements remain unresolved; no permission, policy exception or rejection is invented.

requirements.criterion: Do not restore or alter the separately protected pre-existing Photoshop document without its required maintainer approval; use separate owned fixtures meanwhile.
requirements.required_evidence: Original restoration context and explicit approval if that action becomes necessary; no inferred approval or speculative restoration.
